function(path, family, expected_sha256) {
    manifest_path <- absolute_path(path)
    manifest <- read_stored_csv(path)
    assert_columns(manifest, c("path", "sha256", "bytes", "producer", "artifact_type"), paste(family, "manifest"))
    manifest_sha256 <- digest::digest(file = manifest_path, algo = "sha256")
    stopifnot(identical(manifest_sha256, expected_sha256))
    listed_paths <- absolute_path(manifest$path)
    present <- file.exists(listed_paths)
    current_bytes <- rep(NA_real_, length(listed_paths))
    current_sha256 <- rep(NA_character_, length(listed_paths))

function(estimate, conf_low, conf_high, effect_type, display_unit) {
    output <- rep("—", length(estimate))
    finite <- is.finite(estimate) & is.finite(conf_low) & is.finite(conf_high)
    multiplicative <- finite & effect_type %in% c("ratio", "odds_ratio")
    output[multiplicative] <- paste0("×", formatC(estimate[multiplicative], format = "f", digits = 2), " [", formatC(conf_low[multiplicative], format = "f", digits = 2), "–", formatC(conf_high[multiplicative], format = "f", digits = 2), "]")
    additive <- finite & !multiplicative
    unit_suffix <- case_when(display_unit[additive] == "clock time" ~ " h", display_unit[additive] %in% c("h", "lx", "lx·h") ~ paste0(" ", display_unit[additive]), TRUE ~ "")
    output[additive] <- paste0(formatC(estimate[additive], format = "f", digits = 2), " [", formatC(conf_low[additive], format = "f", digits = 2), "–", formatC(conf_high[additive], format = "f", digits = 2), "]", unit_suffix)
    output
}

function(estimate, conf_low, conf_high) {
    output <- rep("—", length(estimate))
    finite_estimate <- is.finite(estimate)
    finite_interval <- finite_estimate & is.finite(conf_low) & is.finite(conf_high)
    output[finite_estimate] <- paste0(formatC(100 * estimate[finite_estimate], format = "f", digits = 1), "%")
    output[finite_interval] <- paste0(formatC(100 * estimate[finite_interval], format = "f", digits = 1), "% [", formatC(100 * conf_low[finite_interval], format = "f", digits = 1), "–", formatC(100 * conf_high[finite_interval], format = "f", digits = 1), "]")
    output
}

    result[ratio] <- sprintf("%.2f× (%.2f to %.2f)", estimate[ratio], lower[ratio], upper[ratio])
